mapper.sql: telegram_groups.id AS id, telegram_groups.name AS `name`, telegram_groups.chat_id AS chatId, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy, telegram_groups.created AS created, telegram_groups.modified AS modified
FROM telegram_groups LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = telegram_groups.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = telegram_groups.modified_by

WHERE telegram_groups.is_active = 1
AND telegram_groups.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText},'%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO telegram_groups ( name, chat_id, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{telegramNotification.name}, #{telegramNotification.chatId}, NOW(), #{telegramNotification.createdBy}, 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE telegram_groups SET `name` = #{telegramNotification.name}, `chat_id` = #{telegramNotification.chatId}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{telegramNotification.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{telegramNotification.id} AND is_active = 1
mapper.delete: UPDATE departments SET group_id = NULL WHERE group_id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, name AS name FROM departments WHERE group_id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
